assign.title: AI: handover is a query, not a hand-written file (plan)

log.msg: Step 1 committed 41c165534 (worktree-handover-query): there are three indexes. The live tasks index (SessionIndex) relies on fs.watch alone, with no sweep and no error handler. past-work-index.md has no scheduler, so it is the likely 6-day one. follow-up.md is daily. Proposed fix: SessionIndex.query() calls refresh(), which re-stats every task.jsonl at most every 30 s, plus a watcher error handler. A setInterval rebuild was rejected. Plan only.

Steps 2 to 5 committed d3621f6b0 and the plan merged to michael/dev 376f792f7: /framework/ai/doc/handover-query.md. Step 2: five queries over the tasks source, with 'done' defined as a landing outcome or closed_by. Step 3: one Handover class, a nag for orphaned open tasks, and a start-of-session digest hook. Step 4: handover.md becomes a fixed stub that runs the query, the old text is moved aside by script, the page gets Day/Week/Month chips, and Dashboard DAYS goes from 7 to 30. Step 5: keep task.jsonl (623 mentions across 249 files). Plan only; awaiting the owner.
